facts.text: The hotel blends midcentury modern design with Palm Springs' Rat Pack-era heritage.
facts.excerpt: Thompson Palm Springs blends iconic midcentury modern design with the city’s Rat Pack‑era heritage.

facts.text: The hotel's address is 414 North Palm Canyon Drive in Palm Springs.
facts.excerpt: 414 North Palm Canyon Drive, Palm Springs, CA 92262

facts.text: Rooms are reached along a lush open-air path and are bungalow-inspired, set just above the city for privacy and views.
facts.excerpt: Winding through a lush open‑air path, guests reach 168 bungalow‑inspired rooms set just above the city’s buzz for added privacy and breathtaking views.

facts.text: Every room and suite has a private outdoor space, either a balcony or patio.
facts.excerpt: Discover distinctive rooms, spacious suites, our 21+ Upper Stories adults‑only retreat, and a stylish two‑bedroom Penthouse all with expansive balconies or patios.

facts.text: Room interiors use desert-inspired elements such as soft stone, light woods and neutral tones with vibrant accents.
facts.excerpt: Interiors balance desert-inspired elements—soft stone, light woods, and neutral tones with vibrant accents.

facts.text: Upper Stories is a tower reserved for adults 21 and older.
facts.excerpt: Located in Upper Stories, our exclusive adults-only (21+) tower offers a curated collection of elevated amenities designed for a more refined stay.

facts.text: Upper Stories guests get 24/7 access to a private pantry with complimentary cold beverages, a dedicated pool for adults and in-room Sonos sound systems.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy 24/7 access to a private pantry stocked with complimentary cold beverages, dedicated access to an adults-only pool, an in-room Sonos sound system for an immersive audio experience

facts.text: The 1 Bedroom Penthouse looks out on the San Jacinto Mountains and opens onto a massive wraparound terrace.
facts.excerpt: this expansive 1 Bedroom Penthouse Suite showcases our best views of the San Jacinto Mountain landscapes. A spacious living and dining area flows seamlessly to a massive wraparound terrace

facts.text: The 1 Bedroom Bungalow Suite has the largest terrace on the property, with a private cabana and a dining area overlooking Palm Canyon Drive.
facts.excerpt: This suite features the largest terrace on property with a private cabana, full dining area overlooking Palm Canyon Drive.

facts.text: The hotel has two skyline pools with views of downtown and the desert landscape.
facts.excerpt: Thompson Palm Springs boasts two skyline pools, each featuring views of the stunning downtown and beautiful desert landscape.

facts.text: The pools have cabanas and an adjacent full-service bar serving al fresco bites and craft cocktails.
facts.excerpt: the pools are outfitted with luxurious cabanas and an adjacent full-service bar offering menus of al fresco bites, craft cocktails and more.

facts.text: Guests can reserve a day bed for two by the main pool with a shaded umbrella and a welcome glass of prosecco each.
facts.excerpt: Reserve a day bed for two by the main pool at Thompson Palm Springs and enjoy a shaded umbrella plus a welcome glass of prosecco each.
